title: Whoop theme
description: A stark black-and-white sport-wearable theme: a white page with pure black ink and black bands, greys only for secondary text, an electric periwinkle highlight, a navy secondary band, pastel steel-blue, mauve, cream and mint for plan-card gradients, and a warm amber glow. Figtree throughout, generous 18–30px radii. A near-black dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's black bands use the foreground colour as their surface in light mode and the card colour in dark mode
secondary is a navy band colour with white text in both modes, not a quiet grey
